newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, PUT ENGLAND IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, PUT ENGLAND IN TO BAT.

text.p: Australia won the toss and put England in to bat on the first day of the fourth test at Headingley on Thursday.
Showers caused the start to be delayed by 50 minutes.
England made one change to the side beaten by 268 runs in the third test at Old Trafford, giving a debut to left-arm swing bowler Mike Smith.
Gloucestershire paceman Smith, the leading wicket-taker in the domestic season with 55 wickets, replaced Andy Caddick.
Australia stuck to the side already announced, with Ricky Ponting returning for out-of-form middle order batsman Michael Bevan.
The sides are level 1-1 in the six-test Ashes series.
England - Michael Atherton (captain), Mark Butcher, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Mark Ealham, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Mike Smith, Dean Headley.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Ricky Ponting, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Paul Reiffel, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath.
Umpires: Mervyn Kitchen (England), Cyril Mitchley (South Africa).
